👋🏽 I am Carissa Tracy, PT, MSPT, CertIMT, Founder and Owner @PEARL Pediatric Therapy, PLLC.  “Your lifeline for babies and tots!” Proudly serving in person in New Braunfels, Tx — and serving via Telehealth for anyone in the state of Texas.  
This YouTube channel is to help reach even further out for those that need the information.

Here, we chat about baby development and toddler / kiddo strategies and ideas for thriving!

So friends, let’s fly 🤟🏽  
*subscribe + ring the bell*

📚 👀 
You can follow me for full content / resources on Facebook business page of PEARL Pediatric Therapy, PLLC and Prenatal to PreK Physical Therapy Place Facebook community for more tips and tricks!

We are all different, thankfully.  
So, bring your brains and hearts.
We will be here every week.

#resilient #grace #wife #mom #Christian #clinician  #ASD #neurodivergent
#pediatricphysicaltherapist #advocate #PEARLPediatricTherapyPLLC #forNB #joy #parenting #health #faith
#adaptations #accommodate
#healing
